items.comment: Could you provide the build-system files and pip/setuptools versions? Specifically, please attach the contents of `tools/pythonpkg/pyproject.toml` (or `setup.py` if present) and the output of `pip --version` and `python -c "import setuptools; print(setuptools.__version__)"`. These will show which build dependency provides `package_build` and whether the build environment installed it.
items.label: needs more info
items.rationale: The report shows a ModuleNotFoundError for `package_build` during pip's isolated build step. Reproducing this requires the package build-system declaration (pyproject.toml or setup.py) to know which build dependency should provide `package_build`, and the reporter's `pip`/`setuptools` versions to determine whether build dependencies are being installed into the isolated environment. Without these files and version details I cannot follow the exact failing setup.
